   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><em style="font: inherit;">2023</em> CEO Inducement Grant Plan</span></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The CEO Plan became effective on <em style="font: inherit;"> February 13, 2023 </em>with <ix:nonFraction id="c142134152" contextRef="i_2023-02-13_AwardTypeAxis-RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember_PlanNameAxis-The2023CeoInducementGrantPlanMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">233,332</ix:nonFraction> shares of common stock initially reserved for issuance.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">In connection with the appointment of the Company's CEO on <em style="font: inherit;"> February 13, 2023, </em>the Company granted <ix:nonFraction id="c142134153" contextRef="d_2023-02-13_2023-02-13_AwardTypeAxis-ServiceBasedRsusMember_PlanNameAxis-The2023CeoInducementGrantPlanMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">166,666</ix:nonFraction> service-based RSUs and <ix:nonFraction id="c142134154" contextRef="d_2023-02-13_2023-02-13_AwardTypeAxis-MarketBasedRsusMember_PlanNameAxis-The2023CeoInducementGrantPlanMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">66,666</ix:nonFraction> market-based RSUs to the CEO. The service-based RSUs will vest over <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c142134155">three</span> years. The market-based RSUs would have vested quarterly over <em style="font: inherit;">six</em> (<ix:nonFraction id="c142134157" contextRef="d_2023-02-13_2023-02-13_AwardTypeAxis-MarketBasedRsusMember_PlanNameAxis-The2023CeoInducementGrantPlanMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lidr:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfCalendarQuartersToVest" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">6</ix:nonFraction>) calendar quarters following the satisfaction of the market condition. The market condition would have been satisfied if the closing price of the Company's common stock, as reported by NASDAQ, met or exceeded <em style="font: inherit;">$36.00</em> per share for any <em style="font: inherit;">ten</em> (<em style="font: inherit;">10</em>) consecutive trading days prior to <em style="font: inherit;"> March 1, 2024. </em>As the market condition was <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> satisfied by <em style="font: inherit;"> March 1, 2024, </em>the market-based RSUs were forfeited.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -36pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -36pt; text-indent: 36pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><em style="font: inherit;">2025</em> Employment Inducement Incentive Award Plan</span></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> October 2025, </em>the Board of Directors approved the <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em> Employment Inducement Incentive Award Plan (<em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;2025</em> EIIAP&#8221;) which was created as an inducement for accepting employment with the Company.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The maximum aggregate number of shares of common stock that <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be issued under the <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em> EIIAP is <ix:nonFraction id="c142134166" contextRef="i_2025-10-31_PlanNameAxis-The2025EmploymentInducementIncentiveAwardPlanMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3,000,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of common stock. The awards vest over <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c142134167">three</span> years, with a <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c142134168">one</span>-year cliff of <ix:nonFraction id="c142134169" contextRef="d_2025-10-01_2025-10-31_AwardTypeAxis-RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember_PlanNameAxis-The2025EmploymentInducementIncentiveAwardPlanMember_VestingAxis-ShareBasedCompensationAwardTrancheOneMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingRightsPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">33.3</ix:nonFraction>% of the RSUs on the <em style="font: inherit;">15</em><sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">th</sup> day of the <em style="font: inherit;">second</em> month of the calendar quarter following the recipient&#8217;s <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> year anniversary of their start date. The remaining amounts generally vest quarterly over the following <em style="font: inherit;">two</em> years. The fair value of the RSU is equal to the fair value of the Company&#8217;s common stock on the date of grant.</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The aggregate intrinsic value is the difference between the current fair value of the underlying common stock and the exercise price for in-the-money stock options. The Company did <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c142134176"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c142134387">not</span></span> grant any options during the years ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The total unrecognized compensation expense for RSUs was&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134181" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_AwardTypeAxis-RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedShareBasedAwardsOtherThanOptions" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">1,813</ix:nonFraction> as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em> which is expected to be recognized over an estimated weighted average period of&#160;<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_AwardTypeAxis-RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedPeriodForRecognition1" id="c142134182" format="ixt-sec:duryear">1.49</ix:nonNumeric> years. The total unrecognized compensation expense for the ESPP was&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134183" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_PlanNameAxis-The2022EmployeeStockPurchasePlanMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedShareBasedAwardsOtherThanOptions" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-4">340</ix:nonFraction> as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em> which is expected to be recognized over an estimated weighted average period of&#160;<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_PlanNameAxis-The2022EmployeeStockPurchasePlanMember" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedPeriodForRecognition1" id="c142134184" format="ixt-sec:duryear">1.07</ix:nonNumeric> years.&#160; There is <ix:nonFraction id="c142134185" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedStockOptions" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="-3">no</ix:nonFraction> unrecognized compensation expense for stock options as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company uses the Black-Scholes option-pricing model to estimate the grant-date fair value of ESPP purchase rights. The fair value of each of the <em style="font: inherit;">four</em> purchase periods is estimated separately. The Company uses the Monte-Carlo simulation model to estimate the grant date fair value of awards with a market condition. Both models require the input of subjective assumptions such as expected term, expected stock price volatility, risk-free interest rate and dividend yield as discussed below.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;"><b><i>Expected Term</i></b>&#8212;The expected term for ESPP is the length of time from the grant date to the date on which the stock is purchased by the employees. The expected term for awards with a market condition is the length of time from the grant date to the date the market condition expires.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;"><b><i>Expected Volatility</i></b>&#8212;Expected volatility is estimated using a combination of the average historical volatility of the Company's own stock and those of comparable companies&#8217; stock at the time of the grant.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;"><b><i>Risk-Free Interest Rate</i></b>&#8212;The risk-free interest rates are based on US Treasury yields in effect at the grant date for notes with comparable terms as the awards.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;"><b><i>Dividend Yield</i></b>&#8212;The expected dividend-yield assumption is based on the Company&#8217;s current expectations about its anticipated dividend policy.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The Company has&#160;<span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c142134188">one</span>&#160;reportable segment managed on a consolidated basis by the Chief Executive Officer ("CEO") who is the chief operating decision maker (&#8220;CODM&#8221;). In identifying&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">one</em>&#160;reportable segment, the Company considered the basis of organization for the design and development of high-performance, active lidar systems and&#160;applications.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -9pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The accounting policies of the segment are the same as those described in the summary of significant accounting policies. The CODM assesses performance and decides how to allocate resources based on consolidated net loss as reported in the consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss.&#160; There are <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> other expense categories regularly provided to the&#160;CODM&#160;that are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> already included in the consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss. The measure of segment assets is reported on the balance sheet as cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities.</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company recorded revenue for product&#160;sales of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134194" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_ProductOrServiceAxis-ProductMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">157</ix:nonFraction>&#160;and $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134195" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_ProductOrServiceAxis-ProductMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">97</ix:nonFraction>&#160;in <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>, respectively.    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i>Contract Liabilities</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company had <ix:nonFraction id="c142134202" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiability" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="-3">no</ix:nonFraction> contract liabilities as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i>Remaining Performance Obligations</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Revenue allocated to remaining performance obligations represents the transaction price allocated to the performance obligations that are unsatisfied, or partially unsatisfied. It includes unearned revenue and amounts that will be invoiced and recognized as revenue in future periods and does <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> include contracts where the customer is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> committed. The customer is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> considered committed where they are able to terminate for convenience without payment of a substantive penalty under the contract. Additionally, as a practical expedient, the Company has <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> disclosed the value of unsatisfied performance obligations for contracts with an original expected length of <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> year or less.&#160;</p>
  </ix:nonNumeric>
  <div>
   &#160;
  </div>
  <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31" name="us-gaap:RestructuringAndRelatedActivitiesDisclosureTextBlock" id="c3138618" escape="true">
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px;"><tbody><tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 36pt;"> <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size: 10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">17.</em></b></p> </td><td style="width: auto;"> <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size: 10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>RESTRUCTURING</b></p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt;text-indent:36pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;">2023,</em> the Company&#160;implemented&#160;a revised strategic plan, which focused on key products and critical customer engagements in the Automotive market, and aligned&#160;the Company's operations with evolving business needs by focusing on a transition from research and development to the commercialization of the Company's automotive products, while winding down the legacy&#160;Non-Automotive product, and reducing fixed operating costs.&#160;In <em style="font: inherit;"> August 2024, </em>the Company further reduced fixed operating costs and terminated its headquarters lease.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company recorded a net gain of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134211" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RestructuringCharges" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3" sign="-">368</ix:nonFraction>&#160;during the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024, </em>primarily relating to the net gain on termination of lease, partially offset by losses on purchase commitments and <em style="font: inherit;">one</em>-time termination benefits.&#160; Restructuring-related liabilities were included in accrued expenses and other current liabilities in the consolidated balance sheet.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company reports income taxes in accordance with ASC <em style="font: inherit;">740,</em> which requires an asset and liability approach in accounting for income taxes. Deferred tax assets and liabilities are recognized for the future tax consequences attributable to differences between the financial statement carrying amounts of existing assets and liabilities and their respective tax bases, as well as net operating loss and tax credit carryforwards. Deferred tax amounts are determined by using the enacted tax rates expected to be in effect when the temporary differences are expected to be recovered or settled. The effect on deferred tax assets and liabilities of a change in tax rates is recognized in income in the period that includes the enactment date. A valuation allowance reduces the deferred tax assets to the amount that is more likely than <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> to be realized.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Realization of deferred tax assets is dependent on future taxable earnings, if any, the timing and amount of which are uncertain. The Company has a history of operating losses and has incurred cumulative book losses since its formation. Based upon the history of losses, the Company has determined that it is more likely than <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> that the net deferred tax assets will <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> be realized, and accordingly, a full valuation allowance has been recorded against its net deferred tax assets. The valuation allowance as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em> was&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134254" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">109,546</ix:nonFraction> which increased from&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134255" contextRef="i_2024-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">101,954</ix:nonFraction> at <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em>. The increase in the valuation allowance is primarily related&#160;to additional deferred tax assets recorded for net operating losses and research credits generated during the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Company had&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134256" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">362,183</ix:nonFraction> and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134257" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">268,734</ix:nonFraction> of federal and state net operating losses available to reduce future taxable income, respectively, of which&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134258" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="lidr:OperatingLossCarryforwardsSubjectToExpiration" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">12,256</ix:nonFraction> will begin to expire in <em style="font: inherit;">2033</em> for federal tax purposes and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134260" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="lidr:OperatingLossCarryforwardsSubjectToExpiration" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">268,734</ix:nonFraction> will begin to expire in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2029</em> for state tax purposes. Approximately&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134262" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="lidr:OperatingLossCarryforwardsNotSubjectToExpiration" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">349,927</ix:nonFraction> of federal net operating loss included above can be carried forward indefinitely.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em>, the Company had&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134263" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">284,368</ix:nonFraction>&#160;and $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134264" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">241,652</ix:nonFraction>&#160;of federal and state net operating losses available to reduce future taxable income, which will begin to expire in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2033</em> for federal and&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2029</em>&#160;for state tax purposes.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company also has federal and state research and development tax credit carryforwards of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134267" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember_TaxCreditCarryforwardAxis-ResearchMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">8,824</ix:nonFraction> and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134268" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember_TaxCreditCarryforwardAxis-ResearchMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">6,749</ix:nonFraction> as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em> and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134269" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember_TaxCreditCarryforwardAxis-ResearchMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">8,203</ix:nonFraction> and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134270" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember_TaxCreditCarryforwardAxis-ResearchMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">6,255</ix:nonFraction> as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em>. The federal credits begin to expire in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2034</em> and the state credits have <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> expiration date.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Under Section <em style="font: inherit;">382</em> of the Internal Revenue Code of <em style="font: inherit;">1986,</em> as amended, the Company&#8217;s ability to utilize NOL or other tax attributes, such as research tax credits, in any taxable year, <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be limited if the Company has experienced an &#8220;ownership change.&#8221; Generally, a Section <em style="font: inherit;">382</em> ownership change occurs if there is a cumulative increase of more than <em style="font: inherit;">50</em> percentage points in the stock ownership of <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> or more stockholders or groups of stockholders who owns at least <em style="font: inherit;">5%</em> of a corporation&#8217;s stock within a specific testing period. Similar rules <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>apply under state tax laws. Based on the Section <em style="font: inherit;">382</em> analysis performed through <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2021, </em>the Company concluded all of its NOLs and credits would be available to use as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2021, </em>however, future changes in ownership <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>limit the ability to use tax attributes under Section <em style="font: inherit;">382.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company recognizes interest and penalties related to income tax matters as a component of income tax expense. As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em> there was <ix:nonFraction id="c142134282" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued" scale="3" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="-3">no</ix:nonFraction> accrued interest nor penalties related to uncertain tax positions.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company files income tax returns in the U.S., various state jurisdictions, and foreign jurisdictions. The U.S., state and foreign jurisdictions have statutes of limitations that generally range from <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> to <em style="font: inherit;">five</em> years. Due to the Company&#8217;s net losses, substantially all of its federal, state and local income tax returns are subject to examination for federal and state purposes since inception. The Company is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> currently under examination for federal or state income tax purposes.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">In accordance with the requirements of ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">09</em> for the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025, </em>cash paid for income taxes totaled was $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134288" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">58</ix:nonFraction>&#160;and was comprised of state income taxes of $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134289" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-CaliforniaFranchiseTaxBoardMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterRefundReceived" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;made primarily to California, and $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134290" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-KoreaTaxAuthorityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidForeignAfterRefundReceived" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">9</ix:nonFraction>&#160;and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c142134291" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-FederalMinistryOfFinanceGermanyMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidForeignAfterRefundReceived" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">47</ix:nonFraction>&#160;for foreign taxes paid in Korea and Germany, respectively.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> July 4, 2025, </em>the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (&#8220;OBBBA&#8221;) was enacted. This legislation introduces several provisions impacting corporate taxes including (i) the permanent extension of certain expiring or expired elements of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act such as <em style="font: inherit;">100%</em> bonus depreciation and favorable modifications related to deductibility of interest, and (ii) expensing of research and experimental expenses. The OBBBA contains multiple effective dates, with some provisions applicable beginning in <em style="font: inherit;">2025.</em>&#160;Because of the Company's valuation allowance on its net deferred tax assets, the change did <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> have a material&#160;impact on&#160;its financial statements.&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt; text-indent: 36pt;"><b><i>Legal Matter</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be subject to legal proceedings and claims that arise in the ordinary course of business.&#160;Litigation&#160;can be expensive and disruptive to normal business operations. Moreover, the results of complex legal proceedings are difficult to predict and the Company&#8217;s view of these matters <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>change in the future as the litigation and events related thereto unfold. The Company expenses legal fees as incurred.&#160;The Company records a provision for contingent losses when it is both probable that a liability has been incurred and the amount of the loss can be reasonably estimated.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">In&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2025,</em>&#160;the Company was notified by a former vendor that it intended to pursue a claim against the Company&#8217;s wholly owned subsidiary, AEye Technologies, Inc., arising out of an agreement entered into in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> May 2020,&#160;</em>in which the former vendor alleges that AEye Technologies, Inc. failed to pay approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134297" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_LitigationCaseAxis-FailureOfPaymentMember_LitigationStatusAxis-PendingLitigationMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LossContingencyEstimateOfPossibleLoss" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">3,300</ix:nonFraction>&#160;plus&#160;interest from the date the former vendor alleges such payments were due.&#160;In <em style="font: inherit;"> February 2026, </em>the former vendor initiated a binding arbitration proceeding against AEye Technologies, Inc. pursuant to the underlying purchase agreement. AEye Technologies, Inc. has, and continues to dispute the total amount owed based, in part, on the claim that the products supplied by the former vendor were largely defective and such former vendor was repeatedly made aware of the existence of such defects.&#160;While it is reasonably possible that a loss <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be incurred, the Company is unable to estimate the possible loss or range of loss that could result from an unfavorable outcome in this legal proceeding.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">In&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2024,</em>&#160;the Company was purportedly served with a complaint&#160;that (<em style="font: inherit;">1</em>)&#160;alleged&#160;the Company was&#160;in breach of the lease for&#160;its former headquarters office in Dublin, California because of the Company&#8217;s failure to pay rent as required by the lease and (<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>)&#160;provided&#160;notice that the lease had been terminated by the landlord effective as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> August 23, 2024.&#160;</em>The landlord claimed that the amount owed could be up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134301" contextRef="i_2024-08-28_LitigationCaseAxis-AllegedBreachInLeaseMember_LitigationStatusAxis-PendingLitigationMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LossContingencyEstimateOfPossibleLoss" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">8,500</ix:nonFraction>. Thereafter, in <em style="font: inherit;"> August 2024, </em>the landlord fully drew&#160;down the standby letter of credit of $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134302" contextRef="i_2024-08-28_LitigationCaseAxis-AllegedBreachInLeaseMember_LitigationStatusAxis-PendingLitigationMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LettersOfCreditOutstandingAmount" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-4">2,150</ix:nonFraction>, which was held as security for the payment of rent, due to the alleged default of the lease. On&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> April 28, 2025,&#160;</em>the Company and the former landlord entered into a&#160;settlement agreement to resolve all outstanding disputes related to the early termination of the lease.&#160;Under the terms of the agreement, the&#160;Company paid $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134303" contextRef="d_2025-05-01_2025-05-01_LitigationCaseAxis-AllegedBreachInLeaseMember_LitigationStatusAxis-SettledLitigationMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LitigationSettlementAmountAwardedToOtherParty" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1,400</ix:nonFraction>&#160;in cash in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> May 2025&#160;</em>and issued warrants to purchase up to&#160;<ix:nonFraction id="c142134304" contextRef="i_2025-08-31_ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis-WarrantsIssuedForEarlyTerminationOfTheLeaseMember_LitigationCaseAxis-AllegedBreachInLeaseMember_LitigationStatusAxis-SettledLitigationMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">350,000</ix:nonFraction>&#160;shares of common stock at an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c142134305" contextRef="i_2025-08-31_ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis-WarrantsIssuedForEarlyTerminationOfTheLeaseMember_LitigationCaseAxis-AllegedBreachInLeaseMember_LitigationStatusAxis-SettledLitigationMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">2.22</ix:nonFraction>&#160;per share in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> August 2025.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><a id="controls" title="controls" href="#"></a>Item 9A. Controls and Procedures</b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures</b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">We have established disclosure controls and procedures that are designed to ensure that the information required to be disclosed by us in the reports that we file or submit under the Exchange Act is recorded, processed, summarized, and reported within the time periods specified in SEC rules and forms and that such information is accumulated and communicated to management, including our principal executive officer and principal financial officer, as appropriate to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure.</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Under the supervision and with the participation of our management, including our principal executive officer and principal financial officer, we have evaluated the effectiveness of our disclosure controls and procedures as required under Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Exchange Act as of December 31, 2025. Based on this evaluation, our principal executive officer and principal financial officer have concluded that these disclosure controls and procedures were effective at the reasonable assurance level as of December 31, 2025.</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Management</b>&#8217;<b>s Annual Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting</b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Our management is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting, as defined in Rule 13a-15(f) and 15d-15(f) under the Exchange Act. Under the supervision of and with the participation of our principal executive officer and principal financial officer, our management assessed the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025 based on the criteria set forth by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission in <i>Internal Control-Integrated Framework</i> (2013). Based on this assessment, management has concluded that our internal control over financial reporting was effective as of December 31, 2025.</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">This Annual Report on Form 10-K does not include an attestation report of our independent registered public accounting firm on our internal control over financial reporting. Management&#8217;s report was not subject to attestation by the Company&#8217;s registered public accounting firm pursuant to the rules of the SEC that permit non-accelerated filers such as our company to provide only management&#8217;s report in the Annual Report on Form 10-K.</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Inherent Limitations on Effectiveness of Controls</b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Our management, including our principal executive officer and principal financial officer, has determined that our internal controls are reasonably designed and implemented to assure reliable financial reporting and preparation of our financial statements. However, because of the inherent limitations in all control systems, no evaluation of controls can provide absolute assurance that misstatements due to error or fraud will not occur or that all control issues and instances of fraud, if any, have been detected. The design of any system of controls is based in part on certain assumptions about the likelihood of future events and there can be no assurance that any design will succeed in achieving its stated goals under all potential future conditions. Projections of any evaluation of the effectiveness of controls to future periods are subject to risks. Over time, controls may become inadequate because of changes in conditions or deterioration in the degree of compliance with policies or procedures.</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Changes in Internal Control Over Financial Reporting</b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Other than described above, there was no change in our internal control over financial reporting (as defined in Rules 13a-15(f) and 15d-15(f) under the Exchange Act) that occurred during the annual period ended December 31, 2025 that has materially affected, or is reasonably likely to materially affect, our internal control over financial reporting.</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
